Morgan Lee: Quick proposal — add console presets for per-plan graceful throttles + explicit model-fallback chains by region. want to avoid hard 429s for free tier but still protect capacity. :thinking:
Sanjay Patel: Do you mean soft-throttle windows (delay + token cut) vs hard rejects? need clear semantics for billing + metrics.
Morgan Lee: yep. soft-throttle = enqueue delay + 20% token trim suggestion; hard-reject only when safety/fraud or sustained overcommit. billing stays on accepted tokens only.
Elaine Wu: FWIW I'd like three controls per plan: 1) concurrency cap, 2) async-queue-length & delay policy, 3) fallback-variant-order. This lets us route free->pro->enterprise and modelA->modelA-quant->modelB-compact.
Tomas Alvarez: Important: region affinity should be first-class. fallback chain can cross regions if same tenant permits, but we should annotate latency delta in telemetry and let tenant opt-out.
Morgan Lee: Sketch of console preset (for API + saved preset):
```json
{
  "plan": "free",
  "concurrency": 4,
  "soft_throttle": {
    "enqueue_ms": 150,
    "token_trim_pct": 20
  },
  "fallback_chain": ["gpt-small-8bit", "gpt-micro-quant"],
  "cross_region_fallback": false
}
```
Maya (DevX): UX Q — when a request is routed to fallback variant we should show both the route and the reason inline in traces and in the console request detail. e.g., `route: fallback(gpt-micro-quant) because queue>max`. Also need a canary toggle for changing presets. :eyes: 
ops-bot: Current avg p95 queue delay (global) = 110ms; free-tier queue spikes at 700ms during peak - last 10m.
Elaine Wu: Telemetry names proposal: `routing.fallback.invoked`, `routing.throttle.soft_applied`, `routing.throttle.hard_reject`, `routing.region.fallback` with tags: plan, tenant_id, target_variant, source_region, target_region. That will make dashboards simple.
Sanjay Patel: API compatibility: if we add `soft_throttle` field, SDKs must ignore unknown fields. We should version the policy API (v1 -> v2) and provide migration script that maps old `quota_limit` -> new concurrency + queue.
Morgan Lee: Edge-case: enterprise tenants might want hard guarantees => override presets with `pin=true` that disables fallback and throttles, instead errors on capacity if pinned. Add `allow_fallback` boolean.
Maya (DevX): For rollouts: canary by tenant count (5% of tenants) + region sampling. Need telemetry bucket for canary vs stable so we can compare cost/latency/regression. Also add an automatic rollback if `routing.fallback.invoked` increases by >5x vs baseline.
Tomas Alvarez: Perf note — enforce fallback ordering in router w/o extra RPCs: build variant chain into routing key so decision is local. Saves a hop.
Morgan Lee: Action items: (1) write policy schema PR with v2 fields (Sanjay), (2) console presets UI mock (Maya), (3) router impl plan for region-aware local decision (Tomas), (4) telemetry + dashboards (Elaine). I'll file tickets and assign. :thumbsup:
Sanjay Patel: ack. I'll start the API spec today and include migration docs.
Elaine Wu: I'll sketch dashboards and provide the alert thresholds for canary rollback.
Maya (DevX): I'll mock the console flows and the canary toggle.
Morgan Lee: Thanks — ping if blockers.
